headlines.text: Looking back to 2024, when the AEW TBS Title found a new home as Mercedes Mone vs. Emi Sakura battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.57 ? ending the champion's reign at 8 defenses. On a special Title Tuesday Dynamite, Mon? retained both the TBS and NJPW Strong Women's Titles over Sakura, the veteran she's credited with shaping her early career.

It was 2021 when The Lucha Brothers vs. The Acclaimed clashed for the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.75. This stood as the 30th match in AEW World Tag Team Titles history ? a real landmark for that championship. Championship gold always raises the stakes.
That Friday in 2021, Ricky Starks vs. Brian Cage put the FTW Title on the line in a Philadelphia Street Fight match, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.58. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2024, when Castagnoli & PAC didn't ease in ? their first AEW match was the main event as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.61.
